definitions.explanation: A pleasant, friendly manner toward others; sociability.
Polite attention or consideration shown to guests or customers.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{愛想|あいそう}がいい。
{愛想|あいそう}よく{接客|せっきゃく}する。
examples.english: To serve customers with a friendly attitude.
I've lost all patience./I've had enough.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{愛想|あいそう}がいい - friendly, amiable
・{愛想|あいそう}が{悪|わる}い - unfriendly, cold
・{愛想|あいそう}を{振|ふ}りまく - to be charming to everyone
・{愛想|あいそう}が{尽|つ}きる - to lose patience, be fed up
・{愛想|あいそう}{笑|わら}い - forced smile, social smile

NUANCE:
{愛想|あいそう}がいい describes someone who is pleasant and approachable in social interactions. {愛想|あいそう}が{尽|つ}きる is an important idiom meaning one has completely lost patience or affection.

RELATED WORDS:
・{愛嬌|あいきょう} - charm, lovableness (more about personal charm)
・{無愛想|ぶあいそう} - curt, unfriendly (antonym)
